title: Enabling ZDX Module Upgrades via the CLI

blocks.text: You can upgrade the Digital Experience (ZDX) Module for Windows via the CLI if you want to deploy an upgrade separately from a Zscaler Client Connector upgrade. Before you can use a downloaded package to upgrade via the CLI, you must enable this feature.
This feature is available only for Zscaler Client Connector version 4.7 and later for Windows.
To enable ZDX Module upgrades via the CLI:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Infrastructure > Client Connector > Windows.
On the Platform Settings tab, click Edit.
In the Edit Platform Settings window, under General Settings, enable Allow ZDX Client Upgrade via CLI.
